description: Resolve a city or country name to a location URI. Pass the `uri` as location_uris to search_articles / search_events to find news that happened there. Does not consume search tokens.

lang.description: Language of the prefix, ISO 639-3 (default eng).

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

name: suggest_locations
